title: Stratus Cove AI
text:
Stratus Cove AI

architecture_fit_summary:
Customer requires fully private VPC deployment in their AWS accounts (account-per-environment). Preferred pattern: Redwood control plane in customer VPC via PrivateLink endpoints + dedicated inference clusters in private subnets. Inbound traffic: only from internal app VPCs via Transit Gateway/VPC peering or PrivateLink; no public ELB exposure. Outbound: tightly restricted; only to S3 endpoints and internal telemetry endpoints via VPC endpoints; optional egress through customer-approved NAT with logging. KMS: BYOK required with CMKs in customer account; HSM/FIPS validation required for certain data classes. Audit logs: flow logs + CloudWatch/CloudTrail streaming to customer SIEM (Splunk) via Kinesis/Firehose. Data residency: model artifacts and logs must be pinned to us-east-2 and eu-west-1 for EU accounts. Overall: high fit but needs formal security sign-off and BYOK legal language.

notes:
Prospect: Stratus Cove AI — underwriting/risk platform for commercial lending. Short notes from AE/SE/Legal threads:
- Key quote from Head of Security: "We cannot allow inference traffic over public internet; all control plane comms must be private and auditable."
- POC ask: 2-week private VPC POC running a reranking pipeline + chat assistant; sample throughput target: 500 qps peak with 50ms tail latency target for short prompts.
- Network: prefer Transit Gateway to stitch multiple accounts; asked about Transit Gateway attachments limits and cost profile.
- KMS: BYOK - they want CMKs in their account and a Rexist check for key rotation + HSM/FIPS cert; need sample IAM trust policy for RW service.
- Audit: must forward CloudTrail+FlowLogs to Splunk with 1y retention; need proof of immutable logging and retention controls.
- Compliance: SOC2 in contract required, ISO27001 preferred; DP team asked about data-at-rest encryption for model cache layers and whether Redwood supports disk encryption with customer keys.
- Blocker: Legal requests BYOK indemnity language; Procurement asks for deployment diagram and runbook to attach to SOW.
- Competitors in bake-off: in-house serving (already have a small infra team), and one managed player who cannot offer BYOK.
- Internal notes: SE to prepare VPC template (PrivateLink endpoints, NAT egress pattern, endpoint services), KMS BYOK integration doc, and audit forwarding playbook.
- Next meeting scheduled 2026-03-18 for architecture/design review (security + infra).

blockers:
legal review for BYOK clause
FIPS/HSM proof for encryption
data residency certification for EU nodes
network egress policy details (zero public egress requirement)

sales_pitch_positioning:
Emphasize unified runtime + auditability: same API used across hosted and private but with customer-managed keys and networking. Highlight Redwood's control-plane minimal trust model via PrivateLink, and runbook for audit-forwarding and retention. Stress cost predictability with Dedicated reserve and Optimize recommendations for quantization and batching to meet 50ms SLO.
